g.text: Korean (Hangul) is a Modular Alphabet (67 Symbols). LLMs See 11,172 Meaningless Opaque Blobs.
Production tokenizers treat compositional Korean syllables as statistical byte soup.
67 JAMO (Korean Modular Alphabet) SYMBOLS · FINITE PALETTE
SCALE PARADOX : 11,172 MEANINGLESS OPAQUE BLOBS vs 67 MODULAR ALPHABET SYMBOLS
⚠️ 99.4% Syllables Missing in Standard Vocabs → 6.0× ~ 9.3× Token Inflation
Korean is a modular alphabet. 11,172 standalone tokens is like English without the alphabet.
Solution: Add ~10 lines of modular pre-tokenization → 0% token explosion & 100% structural awareness.
